provenance.scope: Scan pages of the complete library digitisation, including boards, guard leaves and blanks. Not a count of manuscript folios, and no folio number is inferred from the scan order. Page kinds follow the measured rule recorded on each page.
provenance.kind_validation: The rule was checked against scan pages 1 to 5 and the last four pages of each volume, read as images before the rule was fixed.
provenance.page_kind_basis: Covers inspected. Every other page is a manuscript face unless the measured ink fraction is under 0.015 and the dark fraction under 0.003, which is recorded as blank.
